data.description:
testing_mode: GREEN

Rewrite process_status() in plugins/dso/scripts/ticket_reducer/_processors.py. Makes T12 tests pass.

Current code accumulates conflicts in state['conflicts'] but never resolves them. Replace with:

def process_status(state, event, data, filepath):
    current_status = data.get('current_status')
    if current_status is not None and current_status != state['status']:
        # Fork detected: apply lexical UUID tie-break
        incoming_parent = data.get('parent_status_uuid', '')
        # lower parent_status_uuid wins
        # compare with the event currently represented in state
        # state must track current_chain_uuid for tie-break comparison
        # winner's target_status applied to state['status']
        # emit PARENT_CHAIN_FORK_RESOLVED to stderr
    else:
        state['status'] = data.get('status', state['status'])

Emit to stderr: PARENT_CHAIN_FORK_RESOLVED source=<winner-uuid> dropped=<loser-uuid> target_status=<winner-target>
Remove state['conflicts'] accumulation entirely — do not initialize it, do not write to it.

depends_on: T12 (dce5-b47a)
Story DD coverage: SC7
Retry budget: 2 attempts
data.title: GREEN: replace conflict accumulation with fork detection + tie-break in _processors.py
